sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B Balanced 2B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for on‑device inference. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.

sources.snippet: This is based on the implementation of Qwen3.5-2B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. More details on model performance across various devices, can be found here. Qualcomm AI Hub Models uses Qualcomm AI Hub Workbench to compile, profile, and evaluate this model.
